advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Suppress or redirect the human-readable plan-review summary (and route the disposition into the JSON envelope) when `claim --review` is invoked with `--output json`.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/claim.py:118: `    _render_plan_review_text(result)` — called unconditionally, no `fmt` awareness
_render_plan_review_text writes to stdout: src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py:586 `sys.stdout.write(f"PLAN REVIEW: {v} for {result.get('ticket_id')}\n")`

claim_cli honours JSON on both success (src/rebar/_commands/claim.py:346-347 `if fmt == "json": sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result) + "\n")`) and error (claim.py:330-341 writes error_envelope to stdout)
Usage advertises the combination: `Usage: rebar claim <ticket_id> ... [--review] [--output json]` (docs/cli-reference.md / help/claim.txt)
_review_before_claim receives no `fmt`/`repo_root`-derived format signal (signature `def _review_before_claim(ticket_id, tracker, repo_root)` at claim.py:86)
advisory.finding: `claim --review --output json` corrupts the JSON stdout contract: `_review_before_claim` unconditionally writes the human-readable plan-review summary to stdout via `_render_plan_review_text(result)`, regardless of the requested output format. When a review runs, that text is emitted on stdout before the final JSON object (`json.dumps(result)` on PASS at claim.py:347, or the JSON error envelope at claim.py:331 on a non-PASS raise), so a JSON consumer receives non-JSON leading lines.
scenarios: `rebar claim <id> --review --output json` when the plan-review gate applies and the attestation is stale: stdout carries `PLAN REVIEW: ...` lines then the JSON, so `json.loads(stdout)` fails for the caller.
advisory.suggested_fix: Thread the requested output format into `_review_before_claim` (or gate `_render_plan_review_text` on `fmt != "json"` and emit the review disposition through the JSON error envelope), so stdout stays pure JSON in json mode.
